description: The authenticated user's imported betting-history ledger: W-L record, stake and net over lifetime/30d/7d windows, sync freshness, and their most recent bets. Numbers come only from the user's own imported slips; nothing is fabricated. Set view: app for the current app History summary with its source, currency and limitation rules.

currency.description: Current app view only; ISO 4217 code.

recent.description: Legacy-only: how many recent bets to include (default 5). Do not send with view: app.

view.description: Use the current app History summary; omit for legacy imported history.

name: get_history_summary
title: Betting history summary
